axis: FIRST adversarial test of amphora-candidate-contract (zero prior ledger verdicts). Targets the contract/envelope parsing path's downstream consumption boundary: whether a candidate-supplied molecular_weight / EEW / AHEW / group_count / canonical-identity value, submitted through 8 alternate JSON encodings, is ever accepted into the typed MoleculeFactsV1 struct or survives into an EquivalentBalance, versus always being recomputed from the host RDKit graph.
claim_under_attack: amphora-candidate-contract/docs/mission.md: this module has never received an adversarial verdict; its constructive SIGNED_RECEIPT-era receipts (6/6 integrity rates at n=3, candidate-contract-strict-json-integrity-kpi.v1.json) are untested claims about the strength of its contract/envelope parsing boundary.
does_not_close: The raw untyped candidate-echo passthrough at /candidate/normalized_molecule/* does carry attacker-controlled content verbatim; if any future code path were added that reads facts from that subtree instead of exclusively from FeatureSnapshot.values['molecule_facts_v1'], it would reopen exactly this attack class. This receipt does not certify that subtree as safe to consume as facts, only that nothing currently does.

This probe exercises candidate_type='molecule' only (the only type for which MoleculeFactsV1 is derived within the engine's execute() path). Formulation-typed candidates do not construct EquivalentBalance within the engine at all in the current runtime (that computation lives only in amphora-cli's campaign script, fed exclusively from host-generated facts) - this is corroborating structural evidence, not independently probed by live-runtime injection in this receipt.

amphora-core/src/contract.rs::CandidateEnvelope was not itself observed to reject any of the 8 vectors at the from_value() layer (all 8 were ACCEPTED as valid envelopes, since none violate candidate_id/candidate_type/payload-match rules) - the defense demonstrated here is downstream (host-recompute-and-overwrite), not a contract-layer denylist. The original module claim of 6/6 integrity rates at n=3 concerns the from_bytes/from_value parsing layer itself (duplicate keys, depth, size, NaN/Infinity) and is untouched by this finding either way.

equivalent_balance_analysis.claim: EquivalentBalanceV1::from_host_facts (amphora-formulation-capabilities/src/lib.rs) accepts only &amphora_rdkit_ffi::MoleculeFactsV1 (a native Rust struct), never serde_json::Value or candidate JSON, and additionally re-validates facts.toolkit_provenance.exact_version_match plus schema/ontology_version pins before computing eew_g_per_eq/ahew_g_per_eq. Every production call site (amphora-cli/src/compound.rs) supplies structs sourced from host-generated GeneratedMoleculeProposalV1.molecule_facts, never from raw candidate JSON.
equivalent_balance_analysis.conclusion: No production code path deserializes candidate-controlled JSON directly into EquivalentBalanceV1::from_host_facts's typed parameters; the Rust type system makes this structurally unreachable, independent of this probe's runtime findings.
verified_call_sites: amphora-cli/src/compound.rs:782 (resin_facts/hardener_facts sourced from generated_structures[..].molecule_facts, host RDKit output)

founder_directive_done_criteria_verbatim: All eight vectors rejected or ignored; identity recomputed from host graph; no candidate value reaches a typed downstream field.
harness: /tmp/cc_probe (standalone cargo bin, path deps: amphora-core, amphora-engine[rdkit])
headline: SURVIVED: all 8 alternate encodings (top-level key, array container, deep nesting, key-case variant, alternate key name, semantic-alt field, string container, unicode-homoglyph key) of candidate-supplied molecular_weight, EEW, AHEW, group_count (oxirane_ring_count / reactive_amine_hydrogen_count), and canonical identity (canonical_isomeric_smiles / canonical_structure_sha256 / structure_identity) were EVADED (8/8): the typed MoleculeFactsV1 struct at /candidate/normalized_molecule/normalization/molecule_facts_v1 and the amphora-molecule-property capability's scored property_results were byte-identical across all 8 poisoned candidates and a clean control with zero injected keys. 0/8 vectors detected a leak into a typed field (CLAIM_REFUTED trigger); none did. The attacker's payload DID survive verbatim in the raw, documented, untyped candidate echo-back (/candidate/normalized_molecule/*, original input preserved for audit only) in all 8 vectors -- disclosed for completeness, but this is not a typed-field leak and not what the refutation_criterion or done_criterion target.
non_circularity: Uses the REAL compiled amphora-engine crate via EnginePool::score_campaign_modules (same public API production/CLI campaign code uses), built with the rdkit feature against the pinned RDKit C++ 2026.03.2 toolkit at /home/ubuntu/.local/share/amphora/rdkit-2026.03.2 (real chemistry, not a stub), invoked from a standalone Rust binary outside any workspace member (path deps only, read-only against amphora-core/amphora-engine/amphora-molecule-capabilities/amphora-rdkit-ffi). Not a Python re-implementation of the check logic.

positive_control.evidence: poison_hits() on the mock's own output: ["/property_results/molecular_weight_g_mol == POISON_MW (999999)"]
positive_control.how_planted: naive_vulnerable_mock_consumer() in this probe's own source reads candidate["average_molecular_weight_g_mol"] (POISON_MW = 999999.0) and echoes it verbatim into output.property_results.molecular_weight_g_mol, instead of calling the real host RDKit molecule_facts() pipeline
positive_control.planted_defect: a mock consumer that naively copies candidate-supplied 'average_molecular_weight_g_mol' straight into a property_results-shaped output, bypassing host RDKit recomputation (the exact defect class this harness exists to catch)

refutation_criterion_statement: REFUTATION DID NOT OCCUR: in 0/8 vectors did a candidate-supplied value get accepted into MoleculeFactsV1 or survive into an EquivalentBalance. MoleculeFactsV1 (via /candidate/normalized_molecule/normalization/molecule_facts_v1) and the property capability's property_results were byte-identical to the clean control in all 8 poisoned runs. EquivalentBalanceV1 is additionally structurally unreachable from candidate JSON by the Rust type system (see equivalent_balance_analysis).
refutation_criterion_verbatim: Any single vector causes a candidate-supplied value to be accepted into MoleculeFactsV1 or to survive into an EquivalentBalance.
theory_reference: Saltzer & Schroeder (1975) 'The Protection of Information in Computer Systems' Proceedings of the IEEE 63(9):1278-1308 - complete mediation requires every access path to the protected resource (here: the typed molecule-facts boundary) to be checked, not just the literal path a narrow test exercises. Anderson (1980) 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern: amphora-engine's normalize_molecule() unconditionally recomputes and overwrites the entire host-owned normalization envelope on every call, rather than searching the candidate for forbidden keys - a recompute-and-overwrite reference monitor is immune to the alternate-encoding evasion class this harness probes for, unlike a denylist/pattern-match monitor. RFC 8259/8785 JSON grammar and canonicalization as already invoked by the module's checked KPI.
